description.value: Shanzee's Biscuit Café is a Victoria brunch spot run by chef and owner Shannon Stead, celebrated for homemade biscuits and gravy and inventive flavour combinations developed at the Carnarvon concession. Voted one of Canada's top 100 places to eat on Yelp, it offers both hearty comfort dishes and vegan-friendly options. Located in Victoria's Old Town area on Pandora Avenue, the café features outdoor seating.
